subject: Aligning SDK telemetry: LangChain / LlamaIndex / PromptWeave integration
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: LangCraft Partnerships <partners@langcraft.ai>, Anoop Shah <anoop@promptsmith.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Telemetry harmonization proposal — LangChain / LlamaIndex / PromptWeave

Hi all,

Thanks for taking the time to start this thread. We saw increasing requests from ISVs to have a single, minimal telemetry contract we can support across LangChain, LlamaIndex and a few popular prompt toolkits (PromptWeave / PromptSmith). The ask is straightforward: make it easy for partners to send runtime traces, token accounting, and cache metrics so Redwood can surface consistent SLOs and cost attribution in the Console.

Attached is a first-pass "telemetry-contract-draft.pdf" and a simple diagram (sdk-interop-diagram.png) showing where SDK hooks would live (client SDK shim -> runtime -> trace export). Key goals:
- Minimal event set (request id, model variant, latency_ms, tokens_in/out, cache_hit, error_code)
- Trace correlation (trace_id mapping to Redwood request_id)
- Privacy-first payloads (no PII, hashed prompt ids)

Questions for the group:
1) Who are the technical owners on your side for SDK changes?
2) Any hard constraints on event sizes, batching windows, or preferred export formats (JSON over HTTP, protobuf, OTLP)?
3) Can we target a short pilot (4–6 weeks) involving a sample app + small cohort of customers?

Proposed sync: Wed Oct 20 11:00 PT (30 min). If that works, we’ll share a rough SOW and acceptance criteria.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com

Attachment: telemetry-contract-draft.pdf
Attachment: sdk-interop-diagram.png

From: Anoop Shah <anoop@promptsmith.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, LangCraft Partnerships <partners@langcraft.ai>
Cc: BridgeWorks Consulting <eng@bridgeworks.io>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry harmonization proposal — LangChain / LlamaIndex / PromptWeave

Sofia —

Thanks for the summary and the draft. PromptSmith (we build PromptWeave) is interested — I'll loop in our lead engineer and the person who owns our SDK. A couple quick clarifying items from our end:
- We prefer an OTLP-over-HTTP export but can support JSON schema if necessary for initial rollout.
- We use a local batching window of ~200ms by default; will that be OK for the Console's near-real-time needs?
- For correlation, we already surface a request_trace_id; if Redwood wants request_id mapped, we can add that as an optional header.

BridgeWorks (cc’d) does a lot of ISV instrumentation; they can scope the SDK shim work if you want to accelerate.

I can make the Oct 20th time, please confirm invite.

—Anoop Shah
Head of Integrations, PromptSmith
anoop@promptsmith.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Anoop Shah <anoop@promptsmith.com>, LangCraft Partnerships <partners@langcraft.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry harmonization proposal — LangChain / LlamaIndex / PromptWeave

Anoop — thanks, good notes. A few operational constraints from Redwood that will drive the acceptance criteria:
- Minimum event contract for the pilot: request_id, trace_id (optional but preferred), model_name, model_variant, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, cache_hit (bool), error_code (nullable).
- Export flavors we will accept for the pilot: JSON-over-HTTP (v1 schema in Drive link) and OTLP. Protobuf can be evaluated later.
- Batching: 200ms is fine for pilot; we want the option to disable batching for critical routes.
- Sampling: we require either full sampling for pilot-specific customers or 1:1 tracing for debug tenants.

I uploaded a living spec to Drive (see related_links). We also sketched the commercial ask in-line: pilot is 6 weeks with a public acceptance checklist (trace visibility, token accounting within +/-5%, and no PII in exported fields).

Can BridgeWorks provide an estimate for the SDK shim (LangChain + LlamaIndex hooks + PromptWeave adapter) and a small SOW? If so, cc me and Marissa and we’ll draft a partner SOW.

Thanks — I’ll circulate a calendar invite once we lock time.

Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

Attachment: sdk-interop-diagram.png
Related doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1XyZk-example-telemetry-spec

From: LangCraft Partnerships <partners@langcraft.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Anoop Shah <anoop@promptsmith.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry harmonization proposal — LangChain / LlamaIndex / PromptWeave

Hi team,

Thanks — confirmed for Wed Oct 20 11:00 PT (we accepted the invite). LangCraft will own the LangChain adapter, PromptSmith will own PromptWeave hooks, and BridgeWorks will be the integrator for the SDK shim as discussed. Our technical lead for the effort is Evelyn Park (evelyn@langcraft.ai) — she will join the call and owns the Jira epic we created: LC-INT-42.

High-level plan we discussed internally:
- Week 0: kickoff + agree acceptance checklist (this week)
- Weeks 1–3: implement adapters and lightweight e2e test app (sample user flows)
- Weeks 4–5: onboard 2 pilot tenants, collect traces, validate token accounting
- Week 6: acceptance review and retro, decide rollout path

We will share a short SOW and an estimate for the BridgeWorks scope before the end of the week. HubSpot record and internal docs are linked here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/LC-7890

Looking forward — see you on the call.

Best,
LangCraft Partnerships
partners@langcraft.ai
